write_authority: eravors_users — §10.1, this engine is the ONLY writer. seedContainedAccounts() defers to it.

operations.editUser: display fields only. Never touches the account key or dbPrefix.
operations.renameUser: SAME person. Data follows. Peer identity and crypto keys PRESERVED.
operations.replacePartner: DIFFERENT person. Data does NOT follow. New peer identity, crypto regenerated, pair torn down.
operations.removeUser: account removed, partners unlinked, data archived or purged.
operations.clearCoCreation: pair state only. Neither person's own journal/vault/codex/feelings touched.
operations.purgeThemes: strips the three retired themes from storage and user records.
operations.exportAll / exportUser: §9.4 first-class, and taken automatically before every destructive op.

failure_modes: no storage available -> constructor throws, refuses to operate blind
unknown user -> throws, naming the key
malformed account key -> throws, stating the rule
key collision -> throws, refuses to merge two people
disposition not chosen -> throws. NO DEFAULT — this decides whether a real person's history is kept
replacing the admin account -> refused, checked BEFORE key validation so the real reason is named
removing the last admin -> refused, the app would be unadministrable
invariants: §0.3 an export snapshot is returned from every destructive operation, asked for or not
§1.2 every operation returns a report naming each key touched — never a bare boolean
§17.5 provenance is not inherited: a replacement issues a new peer identity and regenerates crypto keys
§17.3 rename and replace never share a code path — conflating them orphans or falsifies data
root_cause_fixed: seedContainedAccounts() force-seeded the partner account on EVERY page load, so any rename made through the UI was silently reverted on the next reload — §1.2, a silent failure that corrupts state instead of crashing. The partner slot is now data, seeded once if and only if no partner exists.
status: implemented — 28/28 tests passing, including the end-to-end replacement sequence.
